notes.title: 🛒 THE GRAND BAZAAR 🛒
notes.content:
Oh, this is different, huh?
You thought we’d let those zebras run for free forever?
The age of freebies is over. Welcome to the marketplace.

🛒 THE SHOP IS OPEN FOR BUSINESS!

Now you can buy and sell like a true merchant of illusion.
Zebras? Scratch tickets? Fingers sore from too much scratching?

    We’ve got you covered. It’s all good stuff.

Zebras don’t spit out money directly anymore. You want profit? Go sell them. Time to work for it !

🧾 MISSIONS?

Now they hand out scratch tickets.

    Scratch them, sell them — but whatever you do, just lose.

🏆 New achievements (or humiliations, depends on your point of view)


 ALL IN – Sometimes you gotta lose everything at once to earn respect.
 TILT – You shook it too hard, cousin.
 Dumpster Diver – No poor shaming brother. Sometimes you gotta fall before you bounce.


🛠 FIXES – THE BARE MINIMUM


 Switching tabs in the journal no longer freezes your destiny. And we capped it at 100 lines. Nobody wants your life story.
 Wheel of Fortune: x2 now stacks. Twice the chance… to fool yourself.
 Skipped missions are now logged. About time, right?
 Wheel lighting adjusted. You see it better now? So do we.


You wanted something new?
We gave you better: the illusion that any of this will change your fate.

notes.title: 🎡 SHAKE IT BABY! 🎡
notes.content:
You asked for it. You dreamed of it. You screamed it at your screen like a madman:
“Shake the machine, dang it!”
Well… now you can.

🪙 The Coin Pusher – SHAKE IT!

One button. A real one. Big. Red. Juicy. It vibrates.
You press it — everything shakes. Coins wobble. Physics panics.
And maybe — JUST MAYBE — some of it will fall.

It’s like elbowing the machine in real life, but legal.
(Well... in the game.)

    Don’t go abusing it, alright? You don’t want problems, cousin.

🎰 Slot Machine – NERF TIME


     Now with 5 bet levels (used to be 3 — we're generous like that)
     Jackpot now triggers no matter the bet — even at 1 coin
     Jackpot now scales with your multiplier (!)


Go ahead, take your shot with next to nothing.
It’s like a real casino, except here you’ve got even less chance to win.

🏇 Zebra Race – ALL IN

Save time. Lose everything faster.
You asked for it, and here it is: the ALL IN button.
A single click to ruin it all.

    Don’t press it. Really. Don’t listen to your friends.

📜 Dear Diary – I'M BROKE

Now you can revisit every glorious moment of your downfall!
Relive every poor decision and reflect on the utter futility of your choices.

Don’t worry — we don’t log anything when you dig through the trash.

    Your dignity is safe. (For now.)

🛠 Bugfixes – BUG ≠ SCAM


 No more mini-freezes when the soundtrack changes. We taught the jukebox a lesson.
 Ghost texts when scene-loading too fast? Exorcized.
 "Keymaster: collect scratchcard" mission is finally behaving.
 Coin Pusher kept eating your coins while stuck? Nah. Check again.
 Roulette ball escaping the table ? We installed fences. It should stay. Should.
 Key clipping through prizes in Keymaster? We glued the collisions back together. Fingers crossed.
 And for the 1% of you who couldn’t stack more than 2,147,483,647 coins:   We fixed it. Now you can get even richer — and we love that.


Now go on.
Shake It.
Don’t be shy.

notes.title: ⚙️ MAJOR UPDATE FOR A MINOR OPTIMIZATION ⚙️
notes.content:
Stop everything. Put down your soda, push your cat off the keyboard, and take a deep breath.
Funfair Billionaire just got a FPS boost. Yes, seriously. This game.

🪙 COIN PUSHER POWER-UP

✅ Coin Pusher now running at 120 FPS (unless your PC runs on hamster power).
✅ No more crashes when spamming coins like a maniac (yes, we tested).
✅ Suspiciously smooth gameplay — we honestly thought we were dreaming.

😱 WARNING: THIS IS NOT A DRILL

We’re not sure how it happened. Cosmic alignment? Maybe we finally read the Unity documentation.
Who cares? What matters is that, for the first time in project history:
The game is slightly less of a disaster.

🎩 Conclusion:

Did we fix all the problems? Absolutely not.
Are we celebrating like we just won a Nobel Prize? Of course we are.

Thanks for surviving with us through this buggy journey.
We’re still working on optimization — a little, a lot, or at random.

notes.title: 🎉 FUNFAIR BILLIONAIRE : OFFICIAL RELEASE APRIL 1st 🎉
notes.content:
After months of chaotic development, unpatched bugs, and broken dreams… FUNFAIR BILLIONAIRE is officially launching on Steam this April 1st!

Is the game optimized?
👉 Nope.
Did we still add a brand new minigame to celebrate?
👉 YES. And it’s a banger.

🔑 THE KEY MASTER – MASTER OF NOTHING 🔑

Ever wanted to rage over a minigame that requires pixel-perfect timing and soul-crushing disappointment?
Say hello to the Key Master.

Insert your virtual key, align it perfectly, press the button at just the right moment…
…and watch it bounce off like a sad noodle in slow motion.

A minigame so uselessly precise, it makes the claw machine look like a fair game.
Guaranteed to make you question your motor skills and your life choices.

🎡 So yeah. The game is out. We made it. Kind of.
Between crash reports and weird physics bugs, we hope you’ll enjoy throwing your fake money into our cursed machines.

📦 Buy it. Try it. Regret it.
And don’t forget to leave a review (something deep and poetic like "this sucks, I love it" will do).

Thanks to everyone who supported this janky little disaster, made with love, sarcasm, and a budget of exactly zero.
